g.text: having a rough moment and i'd really appreciate someone to talk to
Of course. What do you want to talk about?
i know you told me to never talk about cephalons with you again
look i know i keep coming back around to them and it's starting to drive you crazy but
i don't ask for much i really don't
but ever since you told me about them i just keep coming back to them in my head
but i need you to be there for me when i need you to be
i just... please? can we just dig into them a little deeper? i just want to know more and it'll give me something else to focus on
and if you can't i don't... i don't know if i can keep doing this sorry
something other than the bees in my head
i don't want to be a burden on you but i also can't feel like i am either
I'm not comfortable with how obsessed you are with them.
Wait, sorry. I didn't mean it. [Apologize.]
it's just so hard for me to explain why
I get it. We're all afraid to die.
sorry this didn't work out i guess
it's just hard for me to explain why i can't stop fixating on them i guess
I get it. It's nice to think about not being trapped here.
I get it. You think you'd be better at being in charge of the "programming."
I get it. You think it'd be fun to be a computer.
it isn't the immortality thing that i'm really interested in
i get why that's a silly idea and why nobody should live forever
nah i shouldn't have that kind of power i know that
i know lettie is super bent out of shape about never getting to leave and being stuck in a time loop
nobody should it seems like absolute power corrupts absolutely yadda yadda
i mean sure but not really
but it honestly doesn't bother me much
as tempting as it'd be to say otherwise and say OOH YEAH NO I WOULDN'T BE THE BADDIE
having a real hard time looking at the mess entrati's made and going yeah good job there buddy
and besides now that we're stuck in 1999 forever... i guess we ARE kind of immortal, huh?
i have everything i could ever want right here
who can really say for sure? look at rusalka and vodyanoi. look at entrati. none of them woke up one morning being like Y'KNOW WHAT
especially with what you've told me about how cephalons tend to come out the other side... not okay
it's not about it being FUN...
games, snacks, computers, my new family
I'M GONNA BE THE ASSHOLE FROM NOW ON
so if he's one of the greatest scientific minds of all time like you said why should i live forever? nah that's not it
do you know what it's like to live your life knowing your head is broken
i'm gonna bet even the orokin thought they were doing the right thing the whole time
knowing that there's something wrong with you that you can't fix without meds that sometimes work and sometimes make everything ELSE so much worse
so, nah, my ego's not that big believe me
that people can't stand to be around you because of it
always left wondering are these people really my friends
so yeah i know cephalons are MESSED. UP.
but give the opportunity to go in and... and just...
just get into the parts of my code that don't work and just
of course i'm gonna be tempted..
So, there's a cephalon I know named Ordis.
This whole time you've been asking about cephalons because you've wanted to "Fix Yourself?!"
Have you ever considered how good you actually have it?
I told you about Ordis. That wasn't his original name.
He lives onboard the orbiter and was programmed by the Orokin to protect the Tenno.
I kept telling you how HORRIFYING they are. How MONSTROUS the Orokin were for what they did to the people the cephalons used to be!
Have you ever really LOOKED AROUND or LOOKED IN THE MIRROR?!
But that isn't who he used to be.
You have FRIENDS. You're ALIVE. You're WHOLE. You're YOURSELF.
He was called the Beast of Bones. He was a bloody mass-murderer whose real name was Ordan Karris.
Back in the day, he was Ordan Karris, a mercenary who made a name for himself working for the Orokin.
the guy who slept with ballas's wife right?
the beast of bones who got glassed for trying to slaughter a bunch of them
He was programmed not only to protect and serve the Tenno...
Which is more than the cephalons can say.
Yeah, um... I lied about that...
What I didn't tell you earlier?
He doesn't have a CHOICE but to be my friend because of what the Orokin did.
Every time he almost remembers who he was, he forces himself to forget again.
how much else have you lied about?
no no don't bother telling me
The Orokin went into his mind and took all the pieces out they didn't like.
Because when he starts to recall what it was like to be Ordan, he feels *hate.*
All the rage, all the hate, all the anger, and violence.
And they told him -- programmed him -- ORDERED HIM.
And he starts to lose the love he feels for the Tenno. For me. For us.
So in a desperate attempt to keep hold of that love, he... deletes those memories.
And I'm left wondering... is any of it real?
Would Ordan Karris even be my friend?
If someone programs themselves to love you, is it real?
Would he even *like* me at all?
Or is all just a lie? A fantasy and a fiction?
I understand wanting to fix the broken parts of yourself.
I truly do. But like *this?* By removing all choice from yourself? All ability to change?
No matter what, Ordis can never *not* be my friend. He will always be forced to love me.
If you reprogrammed yourself to be "perfect..."
Would I be left wondering the same thing about you?
yeah i think i... i'm good, and i'm gonna leave this cephalon stuff alone now...
i can just be good 'ol obnoxious amir for the forseeable future of... one... endlessly looping year... forever... um... yeah that didn't help things at all
hey hon i suddenly need CARBS and i'm betting you might too
hey i suddenly need CARBS and i'm betting you might too
let's go grab some munchies, yeah?
